notes: Pilot with 10 distinct positions and two orientations each: 16 tuning images and 4 evaluation images. Includes openings, constructed middlegame/endgame positions, an empty board and a corner diagnostic; chess legality is not required. Positions are selected or constructed for capture checks, not sampled from a game corpus. This is not a representative recognition benchmark. Review screenshots and annotations before adopting them as data. Record asset permissions before redistributing captures.
